1.w: Praise the Lord. Sing to the Lord a new song. Praise him in the assembly of the godly.

2.w: Let Israel rejoice in their Creator. Let the people of Zion delight in their King.

3.w: Let them praise his name with dancing. Let them sing praises to him to the accompaniment of the tambourine and harp.

4.w: For the Lord takes delight in his people; he exalts the oppressed by delivering them.

5.w: Let the godly rejoice because of their vindication. Let them shout for joy upon their beds.

6.w: May the praises of God be in their mouths and a two-edged sword in their hands,

7.w: in order to take revenge on the nations and punish foreigners.

8.w: The godly bind their enemies’ kings in chains and their nobles in iron shackles,

9.w: and execute the judgment to which their enemies have been sentenced. All his loyal followers will be vindicated. Praise the Lord.
